item.text: The project already has a parser skeleton, but the targeted code is permissive in two important places: quoted keys use naive quote termination, and array splitting silently accepts malformed commas/delimiters. I’m tightening those contracts and adding focused in-language tests before running the authoritative slices.

item.text: The key slices now pass completely. The array slice found two TOML table-semantics cases coupled to arrays: a static array cannot later be extended as a table, and an empty static array cannot become an array of tables. I’m adding explicit static-array tracking at the document level, then I’ll rerun the slices and full suite.
